prompt:
Design a passive first-order RC low-pass filter for a 5 V source, with an unloaded output and nominal cutoff of 100 Hz. Use one resistor and one capacitor, choose standard E12 values, and provide the complete exact pin-to-net graph. Use references R1, C1, VIN, VOUT and GND. Pins are R1 A/B, C1 A/B, VIN 1, VOUT 1, GND 1. Include three nets named VIN, VOUT and GND. Return JSON only using the supplied response schema.
Response schema: {"topology":"string","components":[{"ref":"string","kind":"resistor|capacitor|led|timer555|port|ground","value":"string or null","pins":["string"]}],"nets":[{"name":"string","terminals":["REF.pin"]}]}
